title: deprecate legacy response mode and add V2 fallback shim with header negotiation
author: Priya Raman
description: Context: we're rolling a new v2 request/response schema for the OpenAI compatibility layer that changes streaming chunk shapes and tool-call payloads. To avoid breaking existing clients immediately, this PR introduces a runtime shim that negotiates schema version via headers and provides a V2->legacy translation fallback. The shim recognizes an explicit preference header (Prefer-Schema-Version: 2) and a legacy beta header (X-OpenAI-Beta: schema-v2); when clients request v2 we serve native v2 responses. For clients that do not opt in, the shim will emit a deprecation warning header (Warning: 299 Deprecated legacy-response-mode) and translate v2 outputs back into the v1 wire shape so existing integrations remain functional. Motivation: gives customers time to migrate while enabling server-side V2 rollout and opt-in testing. What this PR changes: 1) adds a negotiator component that inspects incoming headers and routes through the v2 execution path or the compat translator; 2) implements the V2->V1 response translator for streaming chunks, function/tool-call structures, and structured-output envelopes; 3) exposes runtime config flags (compat.v2_fallback.enabled and RW_COMPAT_V2_FALLBACK env var) and a per-customer override in the control plane; 4) includes end-to-end integration tests that exercise streaming + translator and unit tests for header negotiation and warning emissions; 5) updates docs and adds a migration guide snippet to the compat README. Backward-incompatible notes: legacy mode is now deprecation-flagged but behavior preserved by the translator. Migration guidance: customers should start sending Prefer-Schema-Version: 2 or X-OpenAI-Beta: schema-v2 to opt into new schema, and update streaming handlers to accept the v2 chunk envelope (example in docs). Rollout plan: feature gate flipped off by default for a short canary cohort, then enabled globally after 2 weeks of monitoring. Checklist: - [x] negotiator + translator implementation - [x] unit tests - [x] integration (streaming) tests - [x] docs and migration guide - [x] console flag and env var - [x] monitoring and deprecation metrics. Risk/rollback: translator lives behind config flag; revert simply disables the translator and returns to previous routing. Related: ENG-2381 (schema rollout), SUP-5192 (support ticket about streaming mismatch).
